variants.label: Video Player
variants.tooltip: Enables you to embed video or a live feed in a Perspective view.

source.description: The location of the video source.

liveFeed.description: This should be set to true if the source of the video is a live camera feed.

poster.description: The location of the poster image to use as the background while the video is loading and before it has been played.

autohideControls.description: The visible state of the video controls. If set to true, controls will auto-hide when the cursor is not hovering the video.

autoplay.description: Should the video play by default once loaded. NOTE: The video will be muted when initially playing when this is enabled.

mute.description: The muted state of the video's audio track.

play.description: The play state of the video.

seek.description: The time (in seconds) from which the video should start playing.

volume.description: The percentage of maximum volume in use (from 0 to 100).

playRate.description: The speed at which the video will be played (where 1 is normal speed, .5 is half speed, 2 is double speed, etc.).

loadedData.description: True when the current playback position of the media has finished loading; often the first frame.

playing.description: True when playback is ready to start after having been paused or delayed due to lack of data.

paused.description: True when playback has been paused.

progress.description: Number representing the time (in seconds) where playback has occurred.

rateChanged.description: Number representing the current playback rate (1 being normal speed).

seeking.description: True when a seek operation is in progress.

seeked.description: Number representing the time (in seconds) where the seek action was completed.

waiting.description: True when playback has stopped because of a temporary lack of data.

ended.description: True when playback has stopped because the end of the media was reached.

controlStyle.description: The styles to apply to the individual controls.

style.description: The styles to apply to the component.
